svg.title: Cooperation-shaping institutions in multi-agent AI systems
svg.desc: Tree diagram with seven institutional functions branching to the left and six mechanism families branching to the right of a central node labelled cooperative agent society. The left side groups norms, monitoring, and reputation under an information layer cluster, and sanctions, constraints, adjudication and appeal, and repair and reintegration under a consequence layer cluster. The right side groups normative, social, and epistemic mechanisms under a soft channels cluster, and incentive, constraint, and restorative mechanisms under a hard channels cluster.
